$comment: Hand-written English meanings for the Screen noun (screens, document bands, panels, auto panels and the aggregate workbench) of docs/DSL_KEYWORD_REFERENCE.md. See meanings-concept.json for the file format.

screen.summary: One screen of the app, of one archetype chosen by `kind`: `list` (rows of a concept or query), `detail` (one record), `form` (create or edit), `status` (the one row that matters to the viewer, picked with `pick`), `inbox` (items waiting for action), `board` (columns by an enum field, with drag to move), `map` (rows as points), `dashboard` (tiles, charts and tables), `workbench` (an aggregate edited whole), `document` (a printable PDF or CSV report), `picker` (chooses a row for another screen) or `custom` (an app-supplied component). A screen is driven by a concept or query plus expressions, every button starts a flow, and a screen never widens access: `where` only narrows what row-level access already allows. Screen names are unique across the model.

column.summary: A column or field entry of a screen: a field name, or an object that sets a label, a display format and how the value is scaled.

screenAction.summary: A button on a screen. It starts a flow; it is hidden when the user's roles may not start that flow.

mapSpec.summary: How a `map` screen (or a form with a map) places rows: which fields hold latitude, longitude and label, the starting center and the tile source.

widget.summary: A widget of a `dashboard` screen: a tile (one aggregate number), a chart, or an embedded table, list or map screen.

documentColumn.summary: A printed column of a report document, with an optional total.

documentBand.summary: One printable band of an aggregate-bound document: a `header` band reads fields off the aggregate root, a `lineItems` band reads the rows of one of the aggregate's top-level collections.

documentLogo.summary: A document's logo, bound to a property of the document's root concept. Never a URL: the renderer reads the stored bytes and inlines them.

screenPanel.summary: The body of a hand-written panel, declared in the `panel` key of a `custom` screen: data sources, a layout, field bindings and actions. The screen supplies the name; the panel is served at its `route` and is not an experience navigation target.

panelDataSource.summary: A source of rows for a panel: a concept, a query or a procedure, optionally nested under a parent data source.

panelLayout.summary: How a panel is laid out: a table or grid of its data sources, or a console or dashboard of declarative widgets; children nest layouts.

panelWidget.summary: A declarative widget of a console or dashboard panel layout, computed in the browser over the panel's own data sources.

panelSlot.summary: A hand-authored region inside a generated panel: an app-owned component mounted above, below or in place of the generated body.

panelFieldBinding.summary: Binds a field of a data source to the panel's form or table, with visibility and editability rules and presentation hints. Also used by document bands.

panelAction.summary: A button of a panel. It runs a query, a concept mutation, a procedure or a flow.

autoPanel.summary: A panel generated from a concept or an aggregate: up to four surfaces (selection, detail, transaction, prompt) are synthesized and each can be tuned or replaced. The older way; new models use `screens`.

autoPanelSurface.summary: One generated surface of an auto panel. A surface keyword is used only by the surface kinds it makes sense for (for example `layout` and `dataSource` on selection, `regions` and `actions` on the aggregate workbench transaction).

autoPanelDataSource.summary: Replaces the rows of a selection surface with the output of a procedure instead of the concept's table.

workbenchAction.summary: A button on the aggregate workbench. It either runs a procedure over the current draft or checks balance rules; exactly one of `procedure` or `checkBalances`, enforced by the semantic validator.

workbenchActionApplyTo.summary: How an action's result is folded into the draft: appended as a row of a collection.

workbenchBandPicker.summary: A modal row picker offered for one band (collection) of the aggregate workbench.

regionMount.summary: How an addressable region of the aggregate workbench is filled: generated (default), by an app component, or as a paintable cell grid. A mounted component edits through the workbench store, never around it.

cellGrid.summary: Configuration of a `cellGrid` region: a child collection painted as a board where each row is one cell at (row, column) holding a value chosen from a palette.

transactionHooks.summary: Closed set of hooks around the aggregate workbench: when the draft loads, when a field changes, before an action and on validate and commit. Each names a procedure or flow.

transactionDerivedField.summary: A display-only value recomputed from the current workbench draft, either in the browser (`expression`) or on the server (`procedure`).

transactionUiState.summary: A piece of transient UI state (for example a record-type toggle) that `$ui.<name>` predicates on the surface can read. Never part of the commit payload.

slots.screen.title: Heading shown on the screen and in navigation.
slots.screen.kind: The archetype of the screen (see the summary above). It decides which of the other keywords apply.
slots.screen.concept: The concept whose rows the screen shows or edits.
slots.screen.params: Binds the query's declared parameters: a map from parameter name to a literal or an expression (for example `$user.id`).
slots.screen.map: Where rows are placed on a `map` screen, or which form fields a map picks.
slots.screen.actions: The buttons of the screen; each starts a flow.
slots.screen.countdown: Shows a live countdown to an instant, for example a reservation deadline.
slots.screen.empty: What is shown when the screen has no rows.
slots.screenAction.label: Caption of the button.
slots.screenAction.input: Input handed to the flow: a map from the flow's input name to an expression over the current row.
slots.screenAction.visibleWhen: Expression over the current row; the button is shown only while it is true.
slots.mapSpec.label: Field (or expression) used as the point's label.
slots.widget.title: Heading of the widget.
slots.documentColumn.field: The property of the report's concept to print.
slots.documentBand.name: The band's name, unique within the document.
slots.documentBand.kind: `header` (fields of the aggregate root) or `lineItems` (rows of a top-level collection).
slots.documentBand.label: Heading printed above the band.
slots.documentLogo.field: The property of the document's root concept that holds the logo image.
slots.screenPanel.route: The URL segment the panel is served at.
slots.screenPanel.title: Heading of the panel.
slots.screenPanel.dataSources: The row sources of the panel.
slots.screenPanel.layout: How the data sources are laid out.
slots.screenPanel.fieldBindings: Binds fields of the data sources to the panel, with rules and hints.
slots.screenPanel.visibility: Expression; the panel is visible only while it is true.
slots.screenPanel.enabledWhen: Expression; the panel is interactive only while it is true.
slots.screenPanel.explainability: Free-form object describing, for AI and audit tools, why the panel exists and what it shows.
slots.screenPanel.metadata: Free-form notes carried into the compiled model unchanged.
slots.screenPanel.guidePage: Name of the back-office guide page (dashboard) that hosts this panel.
slots.panelDataSource.name: The data source's name, referenced by field bindings, widgets and row actions.
slots.panelDataSource.procedure: Replace the row source entirely with the output of this procedure (or a flow of that name).
slots.panelDataSource.params: Binds the query's or procedure's parameters: a map from name to a literal or an expression.
slots.panelDataSource.parentDataSource: Name of the data source this one is nested under (a master-detail relation).
slots.panelDataSource.parentField: Field of the parent row that links to the child rows.
slots.panelDataSource.childField: Field of this data source's rows that holds the parent link.
slots.panelDataSource.rowOps: The row operations the user may do on this nested data source: `add` and/or `delete`.
slots.panelDataSource.addFormFields: Fields shown in the form that adds a row.
slots.panelLayout.children: Nested layouts, laid out inside this one.
slots.panelLayout.fields: The fields shown by this layout, in order.
slots.panelLayout.metadata: Free-form notes carried into the compiled model unchanged.
slots.panelWidget.title: Heading of the widget.
slots.panelFieldBinding.source: Name of the data source the field comes from (defaults to the panel's primary one).
slots.panelFieldBinding.visibleWhen: Expression; the field is shown only while it is true.
slots.panelFieldBinding.enabledWhen: Expression; the field is editable only while it is true.
slots.panelFieldBinding.readonlyWhen: Expression; while true the field is read-only.
slots.panelFieldBinding.editable: True: the user may edit the field in the panel.
slots.panelAction.name: The action's name, unique within the panel.
slots.panelAction.label: Caption of the button.
slots.panelAction.binding: What the button does: run a `conceptQuery`, a `conceptMutation`, a `procedure` or a `flow`.
slots.panelAction.concept: For a concept binding: the concept.
slots.panelAction.procedure: For a `procedure` binding: the procedure (or flow of that name) to run.
slots.panelAction.flow: For a `flow` binding: the flow to start.
slots.panelAction.visibleWhen: Expression; the button is shown only while it is true.
slots.panelAction.enabledWhen: Expression; the button is clickable only while it is true.
slots.panelAction.permissionRequirements: Permissions the user must hold to see and run the action.
slots.panelAction.explainability: Free-form object describing why the action exists, for AI and audit tools.
slots.panelAction.metadata: Free-form notes carried into the compiled model unchanged.
slots.autoPanel.name: The panel's name. Defaults to one derived from the concept or aggregate.
slots.autoPanel.concept: The concept the panel is generated for. Give `concept` or `aggregate`.
slots.autoPanel.aggregate: The aggregate root concept the panel is generated for (opens the aggregate workbench).
slots.autoPanel.route: The URL segment the panel is served at.
slots.autoPanel.surfaces: Which surfaces to generate: `selection`, `detail`, `transaction`, `prompt`. Defaults to the usual ones for the kind of panel.
slots.autoPanel.selection: Settings of the selection surface (the list of rows).
slots.autoPanel.detail: Settings of the detail surface (one record).
slots.autoPanel.transaction: Settings of the transaction surface (the aggregate workbench).
slots.autoPanel.prompt: Settings of the prompt surface (a row picker used by other surfaces).
slots.autoPanel.metadata: Free-form notes carried into the compiled model unchanged.
slots.autoPanelSurface.filters: Fields the user can filter by on this surface.
slots.autoPanelSurface.columns: Columns shown on this surface, in order.
slots.autoPanelSurface.fields: Fields shown on this surface, in order.
slots.autoPanelSurface.computed: Extra read-only columns computed live from an expression.
slots.autoPanelSurface.labelField: Field used as the display text of a row (for a prompt or selection).
slots.autoPanelSurface.metadata: Free-form notes carried into the compiled model unchanged.
slots.workbenchBandPicker.label: Caption of the picker button.
slots.workbenchBandPicker.multiSelect: True: several rows may be picked at once.
slots.cellGrid.palette: Where the paintable values come from.
slots.transactionHooks.onValidate: Name of a procedure or flow run before the commit; a failure vetoes it.
slots.transactionHooks.onCommit: Name of a procedure or flow run after the commit.
slots.transactionDerivedField.label: Caption of the derived value.
slots.transactionDerivedField.expression: For the `client` tier: the expression evaluated in the browser over the draft.
slots.transactionDerivedField.procedure: For the `server` tier: the procedure invoked over the draft.

inline.screen.countdown.label: Text shown with the countdown.
inline.mapSpec.pickPoints.name: Name of the point, for example `pickup`.
inline.mapSpec.pickPoints.label: Caption of the point on the map.
inline.mapSpec.pickPoints.lng: Form field that receives the longitude.
inline.widget.value.label: Label of the data point.
inline.column.format: How the value is displayed: text, money, number, date, datetime, relative-time, stars, badge, distance or duration.
inline.column.label: The column heading.
inline.column.currency: ISO currency code used when the format is money.
inline.column.value: The field name or expression to show.
inline.column.unitScale: A factor applied before display, for example 0.01 for an amount stored in cents.
inline.agentAccess.photoIntake.concept: The concept a photo becomes a row of.
inline.agentAccess.photoIntake.description: A sentence shown to the user describing what the photo creates.
inline.externalAi.prompts.name: The prompt's name, the first argument of `externalAi.generate`.
inline.externalAi.prompts.description: A sentence saying what the prompt is for.
inline.externalAi.prompts.maxOutputTokens: Upper bound on the length of the vendor's answer.
